snippet.title: Bird Roll 64 - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world.
Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4263060
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
